findings.description: From 00:03 through ~00:09.15 there are consistently 4 steel cups on the table (at 00:09.00 clearly: rear, left, front, and a right cup just in front of the performer's right hand). Between ~00:09.2 and 00:09.5 the right-most cup disappears and only 3 cups remain through the end of the clip. Neither hand touches or lifts that cup — the right hand rests flat on the table and the left hand holds a coin above the cups — and the cup is not stacked, carried off-screen, or occluded once the slow camera move settles. The performer's trick concerns coins, not cups, so this cup vanishing is an unexplained count change.
